assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a single production football club doodle for the Notebook Arcade game.
Primary request: create ONE isolated hand-drawn emblem on a TRUE transparent alpha background. Square canvas. It should look like an authentic teenager's spontaneous blue ballpoint notebook drawing, not polished graphic design.
Style/medium: very dark indigo-blue ballpoint pen, repeated imperfect contours, naturally wobbly lines, open sketch strokes, loose short scratch hatching, slight overshoots, confident casual doodle energy. Thin-to-medium pen weight, strong recognizable silhouette, enough simplicity to read at 60 pixels. White/empty areas inside the drawing should remain transparent except for pen and occasional color hatch marks.
Composition: subject centered and fills about 84 percent of the canvas with a modest 8 percent safety margin. One emblem only. NO words, letters, numbers, caption, label, watermarks, club name, surrounding border, circular badge, background scene, paper texture, white rectangular background, drop shadow, checkerboard, gradients, rendered material, clean vector, smooth geometric icon, or professional esports mascot treatment. Transparent PNG with actual alpha, not a simulated transparency pattern.
Subject: four broken crayons converging diagonally toward a small messy impact in the center, with jagged broken ends and a handful of small scattered crayon fragments. The four short crayons form an energetic rough X arrangement. Simple crayon wrapper bands with NO writing. Restrained rough red colored-pencil hatching within the crayons and a few red hatch strokes behind the center; the pen outlines stay indigo. Loose, lively and imperfect.

duckCorrection.prompt:
Use case: background-extraction.
Asset type: transparent raster club emblem for Notebook Arcade football.
Input image: the approved notebook-style club selection concept, used as the source drawing.
Primary request: extract and faithfully redraw ONLY the duck head drawing from the upper-right Ducks club into one centered standalone square PNG. Keep its actual simple shape, expressive eye, RIGHT-facing flat bill, swept-back shaggy feather tufts, open face, and short ruffled neck. Preserve the natural blue ballpoint notebook-sketch quality, with thin-to-medium imperfect repeated strokes and a few sparse scratch marks. The head interior must stay light and airy: contours and sparse hatching only, no blue flood-fill, no dense crosshatch, no solid heavy chunks. Use the supplied source duck, not a new mascot design.
Remove every other element: paper, notebook ruling, letters, label, words, club names, numbers, circular selection ring, yellow check, other drawings. No text of any kind. No border or badge. No shadows.
Keep only a small restrained group of teal colored-pencil hatch marks behind the duck, much smaller and lighter than the source, plus the blue duck pen strokes. Composition: duck fills 84 percent of the square with about 8 percent margin. Must read as a casual teenager's sketch at 60px.
Require genuinely TRANSPARENT alpha background, not white, not paper, not fake checkerboard. Empty areas between pen strokes and inside the head must also be transparent. Preserve the source's sparse, sketchy outlines rather than making a graphic vector icon.
